title: Olson 2006: muscle on/off timing in supine trunk flexion (sit-up) - FR absent in lumbar paraspinals
condition: supine trunk flexion-extension (sit-up), legs restrained, 10 s cycle

quantity.name: EMG off/on time and peak angles (supine)
quantity.definition: as olson2006.standing_fr_timing; inclination relative to vertical

source.authors: Olson M, Solomonow M, Li L

protocol.summary: 5 cycles supine (sit-up) with legs restrained under a 13.7 kg box (2.3 kg box + 11.4 kg).
how_to_simulate: Supine trunk flexion (sit-up) to peak lumbar flexion 44 deg / inclination 13 deg from vertical, legs fixed
Output: LP should be silent through flexion and active only in extension (51-67% cycle); RA/EO/RF on/off timing
protocol.notes: Surface EMG (right side): lumbar paraspinal LP at L3-L4, 3 cm lateral to the spinous processes; RA 3 cm and EO 15 cm lateral to the umbilicus; RF, SM, BF on the thigh. On/off threshold 5% of the maximal linear envelope across all trials (10 Hz envelope), confirmed on raw EMG. Kinematics: markers on 12th rib, iliac crest, greater trochanter; lumbar flexion angle = rib-iliac line vs iliac-trochanter line; inclination = trunk vs vertical. Cycle: 5 s flexion to touch toes + 5 s extension (metronome 1 beat/s), barefoot, feet shoulder width.

data.x: timing of peak lumbar flexion (% cycle)

extraction.check_notes: Supine inclination is 13 +/- 14 deg (page image); pdftotext merged it as '13714'. n for RA/EO/RF taken from Fig 4 caption (N = 13).

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (angles); for SEM-reported data use SD = SEM x sqrt(n)
